summary: Preserve notice filters and date formats offline, cache PMN notice IDs, detect truncated sweeps, and mark notices seen only after output and delivery succeed.
reason: Unfiltered cache results, silently incomplete sweeps, and early seen-state writes can hide notices or lose a failed delivery.
validated_outcome: Offline tests cover filtered cached notices, numeric and formatted meeting dates, noticeId lookup, truncation detection, failed output, and delivery ordering.
